title: Boundary Record
governance_note: Coupled-system conclusions are not meaningful without a defined boundary and external-flow record.

title: Human-System Record
governance_note: Human assumptions should include constraints, institutions, rights, and distribution where relevant.

title: Natural-System Record
governance_note: Ecological assumptions should include uncertainty, thresholds, and omitted mechanisms.

title: Coupling Record
governance_note: Coupling terms should represent mechanisms, not just arrows.

title: Governance Record
governance_note: Governance should not be treated as a fixed or neutral constant without justification.

title: Equity Record
governance_note: Aggregate efficiency can hide unequal burden, displacement, and environmental injustice.

title: Claim Boundary
governance_note: Coupled-system conclusions should not exceed boundary definitions, data evidence, mechanism plausibility, uncertainty, equity review, and tested scope.
